invalidation_criteria: Saudi Aramco confirms full pipeline restoration and no further attacks, and WTI closes below $95 within 5 trading days
monitoring_horizon: Next 5-7 days: watch Saudi ministry updates, Aramco statements, and OPEC meeting outcomes
